title: Reset file permissions
intro: Gives every file and folder of the site back to its user <code1>{{user}}</code1> and sets the usual modes: folders <code2>755</code2>, files <code3>644</code3>, executable files <code4>755</code4>. Use it after copying files in as root or when the web server answers 403 for files that exist.
private: Files that were private, such as a <code1>wp-config.php</code1> with <code2>600</code2>, become readable for the web server. <code3>.ssh</code3> stays private. Links are not followed, and files on other file systems stay as they are.
confirmHint: Owners and modes of all files of this site change. Running programs keep running.
nothing: Nothing to change: all {{checked}} were already right.
skipped_one: {{n}} entry was left as it is:
skipped_other: {{n}} entries were left as they are:

errors.reset_incomplete: The reset took too long and stopped part way. Run it again: it continues and only changes what is still wrong.
errors.permissions_unavailable: Resetting permissions is not available on this panel.
